title: The info icon on Due on Receipt explains the term on hover
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure all twelve standard terms are active and COD is the default for new customers.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps: 1. Hover the info icon after the name "Due on Receipt".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • After the name "Due on Receipt" there is an info icon and then a lock icon.
  • Hovering the info icon shows: "Payment is due on the invoice date. You can charge the invoice to the customer's account instead of taking payment."

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • S1-R8: “COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold each show, after the name, an info icon and a lock icon. Hovering the info icon shows:”
  • S1-R8, Due on Receipt info icon: “Due on Receipt: "Payment is due on the invoice date. You can charge the invoice to the customer's account instead of taking payment."”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Hover the info icon on Due on Receipt | "Payment is due on the invoice date. You can charge the invoice to the customer's account instead of taking payment." | Tooltip on hover”
  • Key Decisions: “The page explains every term inline in a Due column; only COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold carry an info tooltip.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "1 List and row menus" ("Info tooltip: Due on Receipt"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p1-02-info-tooltip-due-on-receipt.png

The design's own words:

  • “Payment is due on the invoice date, but you can create the invoice without taking payment.”
  • “Only COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold have the info icon. Net terms and day-of-month terms (standard and the shop's own) have none: their Due column already says when payment is due.”
